description: Returns the stored machine record of one past scan: subject, grade, every finding, capabilities with verification, and the evidence roots, manifest and verifier links needed to check it offline. Give a report, d1:, f1: or manifest id, or a domain for its latest. It never scans. For a new scan use scan_domain; for the current signed answer use resolve_domain.
name: machine_record
title: Machine record for a report
